sleep_integrity.policy: Body Battery sleep events are candidates only; never add to confirmed Garmin sleep.

sleep_score_provenance.policy: Use the confirmed sleep-detail score for the recovery model, not the training-readiness component.

v23.note: V2.3.1 reliability overlay; the V2.2 baseline score is retained unless invalid measurements or a restrictive private guardrail block clearance.

measurement_provenance.note: Measurement timestamps are independent from file generation times. Nightly HRV is expected during sleep, not continuously.

sleep_fragmentation.note: User-confirmed extra naps may inform discussion but are not merged with Garmin HRV, stages or sleep-score baselines.

training_guidance.note: Guidance only; no direct measure of neuromuscular readiness, and sleepiness can affect coordination independently of muscle fatigue.

manual_blocks.activity: WOD EMOM 12' - chest to bar / double unders / V-sit
manual_blocks.notes: EMOM 12' (3 vueltas de 4 min): min 1 15 chest-to-bar, min 2 40 double unders, min 3 21 V-sits, min 4 descanso. Garmin 12,0 min.

detail_json.notes: Escalado por el atleta: C2B en lugar de bar muscle-ups y 40 DU en lugar de 80. Día tras TN.

limitations: Unknown loads excluded from verified volume
Patterns are exercise categories, not isolated muscle-group loads
Mixed-equipment totals are not directly comparable; use load_by_equipment
Bodyweight sets do not imply external weight-volume
Machine-stack loads are not comparable to barbell loads
Metcon repetitions and loads are not counted as strength sets
7/28-day comparisons need adequate recorded history
Pain is only included when explicitly reported as structured 0-10 values
Estimated 1RM requires explicitly reported set-level RIR (0-2), not session RPE
Machine loads are descriptive and are not used for free-weight 1RM
Unilateral exercises with unknown side assignment are never doubled

metcon_exposure.coverage: Explicit completed_movements, performed.totals or a confirmed completed per-exercise total; no prescribed-only extrapolation
metcon_exposure.note: Repetitions and distance represent exposure, never estimated force, effective tonnage or medical fatigue.

performance_trends.note: Only explicitly matching benchmark_id, benchmark_variant and metric are compared; no equivalence inferred from names.

limitations: Do not attribute HRV or sleep changes causally to a specific workout or shift
Use actual measurement dates and sleep windows from upstream analytics
Small and uneven context groups cannot establish a personal baseline

previous_week_context.note: El cambio de número de sesiones o RPE no demuestra mejora física ni equivalencia de entrenamiento.

recommendations.text: Esperar al sueño y HRV confirmados antes de fijar intensidad; decidir con sensaciones y calentamiento.
Registrar recuperación 24-48 h y ajustar volumen si coinciden fatiga o bajada del rendimiento; no asumir sobreentrenamiento.
Repetir algún WOD con misma variante, cargas y estándares para comparar tiempos o repeticiones objetivamente.

limitations: Los pesos de barra, máquina y mancuerna no son comparables como fuerza externa equivalente.
Volumen cuantificado es un mínimo declarado: no incluye ejercicios sin peso conocido.
No se suman TRIMP, carga Intervals, carga Garmin ni sRPE entre unidades distintas.
Duración Garmin grabada no es duración efectiva del WOD.
No usar planificados como realizados ni asumir rondas no confirmadas.
Las correlaciones de 24-48h no prueban causalidad y las referencias iniciales son provisionales.

data_quality.scope_note: No activity for 3+ days may reflect rest; freshness of Garmin raw measurements is not verified from this summary alone.

weekly_report.recorded_srpe_note: Only recorded duration x RPE; not equivalent to effective WOD duration, and not comparable with TRIMP.

readiness_latest.note: V2.2: score compatible, no indicador fisiológico independiente. Para decidir usar recovery_assessment_v2.state, status y confidence.
readiness_latest.intensity_guidance: Reevaluar tras el siguiente sueño confirmado; no autorizar intensidad máxima con información incompleta.

weekly_report.recommendation: Interpret trends cautiously; compare only equivalent workouts and consider shift-work and subjective symptoms.
